# Jenna Ammerall — Senior Product Designer

> Making products make sense. As a senior product designer with nine years at
> Microsoft and Meta, Jenna gets to the root of the problem, defines the behaviors,
> and builds the frameworks teams need to carry those decisions across
> products—so everything moves as one. Seattle-based. Focus areas: interaction design,
> product behavior, product strategy, visual craft, and cross-product experience.
> Site: https://ammerallj.design/

Contact: ammerallj@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/ammerallj/

## Selected work

- [Facebook Messaging](https://ammerallj.design/work/facebook-messaging): As Meta scaled back 140M+ app switches from Facebook to Messenger and invested further in private sharing, Jenna aligned the cross-functional team on a shared in-app messaging model to unify 40+ fragmented entry points around consistent destinations and behavior, and focused on the post-send experience. Lead Product Designer, 5 months, 2023.

- [Spatial History for Conversational AI](https://ammerallj.design/work/AI-conversation): Jenna's independent exploration (2026) of AI chat history as a spatial canvas of themes instead of a list of threads. Jenna designed and built the working prototype, Threadscape, with Claude Code, React and TypeScript; the demo runs Gemma 4 behind a small server that holds its rules and limits each visitor. It is a concept, not a shipped product, and it has not yet been tested with people.

Delivery & scale: scenario prototypes, tradeoffs, workback plans, design QA, frameworks, reusable patterns.
